import asyncio
from aiohttp import web

async def test():
    # In 3.13.5, a request without Host header would fall back to socket.getfqdn()
    app = web.Application()
    
    async def handler(request):
        # This would return FQDN in 3.13.5 when no Host header present
        host = request.host
        assert host is not None
        return web.Response()
    
    app.router.add_get('/', handler)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app)
    await runner.setup()
    site = web.TCPSite(runner, '127.0.0.1', 8080)
    await site.start()
    
    # Make HTTP/1.0 request without Host header
    from aiohttp import ClientSession
    async with ClientSession() as session:
        # Raw socket request without Host header to trigger old fallback
        pass
    
    await runner.cleanup()

asyncio.run(test())
